population.exclusion_reason: Category 5 uses refusal-substring accuracy; adversarial_answer is an incorrect lure, not a gold answer.

reference.category1: Keep the complete answer string, including every comma-separated component.
reference.container_types: Reject list/dict/bool/null instead of guessing interchangeable references.
reference.selection: Never select a reference using model probabilities, scores, or predictions.

tokens.prompt: Exact frozen short_prompt_ids; never re-tokenize the prompt or joined strings.
tokens.target: tokenizer.encode(canonical_reference, add_special_tokens=False), without added whitespace, BOS, EOS, or chat terminator.
tokens.hashes: Separate canonical SHA256 for prompt IDs and target IDs, plus concatenated input IDs.
tokens.discarded_sample: One engine-required generated sample is discarded and excluded from targets and loss.
tokens.length_gate: P+A+1 <= max_model_len and P+A <= max_num_batched_tokens; empty targets or overflow fail the complete preparation and report every affected qid. No truncation or silent dropping.

engine.route: One native causal backbone prefill on prompt_ids + target_ids; reuse its hidden states for prompt-logprob LM heads.
engine.hardware: Eight UUID-bound NVIDIA A800-SXM4-40GB; observed nvidia-smi total is 40960 MiB per device, independent of CUDA allocatable capacity.
engine.normalization: Full 248320-token vocabulary; FP32 exponential sum, log and gold subtraction after max selection. Only the gold probability is returned. LM-head GEMM retains model dtype.
engine.penalties: No presence/frequency/repetition penalty or custom logits processors; raw model probabilities.
engine.states: Reuse the same ten final snapshots and fixed donor mapping; same FP32 split PLE read path.
engine.readonly: All seven state fields and frozen identities agree on eight TP ranks before/after each conversation-condition block; existing per-request state guards remain active.

metrics.query_mean_nll: Mean over 1540 questions of each target token-mean NLL.
metrics.token_pooled_nll: Sum of all target-token NLL divided by total target tokens.

bootstrap.weighting: Resample complete conversations; ratio of resampled sums to question counts or token counts.

firewalls.annotations: Open only after all 7944 original four-condition predictions and final exits are sealed and audited.
firewalls.GPU: Full-context remaining 1747 completes first; CPU review and explicit root authorization precede a separate numerical/read-only/memory gate.
firewalls.formal: A successful technical gate and explicit root authorization are required; no automatic retry, fallback, prompt change, or state rewrite.

technical_gate.targets: First frozen qid in conv-48; artificial target [42,43,44,45], plus repeated pattern filling input to 640 tokens. No benchmark reference selection.
technical_gate.comparison_positions: All four short target positions; fixed first/middle/last target positions at full input 640.
technical_gate.comparison: Full-prefill gold logprobs against independent fresh-prefix diagnostic full-vocabulary log_softmax at the preregistered target positions.
technical_gate.tolerance_status: Upper bound only, not bitwise equivalence; record actual maximum and discuss effects near its magnitude.
checks: allocator peak and fresh GPU exit
